pages.title: Feed and heat
pages.text: The Chlorosilane Recycler recovers crude trichlorosilane from silicon tetrachloride with hydrogen, or from distillation residue.$(br2)Supply power and magma heat to maintain its target temperature of 600. Check JEI for each feed combination.

pages.title: Output groups
pages.text: Blue output slots accept crude trichlorosilane, yellow slots accept hydrogen chloride, and purple slots accept other byproducts.$(br2)Provide extraction routes and free space for each group, then return recovered chemicals to the production line.

pages.title: Monitoring
pages.text: Check the screen for missing power, heat, feed, or output space. While waiting for feed, comparator signal 10 can indicate missing hydrogen; blocked output gives signal 15.$(br2)During operation, the comparator also shows progress. Read it alongside the machine state.
